subject: CMMD kickoff — replacing FID in Evalline
body:
Hi Daniela,

Kicking off the CMMD rollout. Our "Rethinking FID" work showed FID's weaknesses as a generation metric — Inception features and the normality assumption chief among them — and proposed CMMD: MMD distance computed on CLIP embeddings (ViT-L/14@336px), distribution-free and better aligned with human judgment. Every image-gen team here still reports FID because that's what Evalline serves. Let's fix that.

Goal (Mar 2 – May 11): CMMD as a first-class Evalline metric — JAX implementation productionized, reference sets hosted, side-by-side CMMD/FID reporting during a transition period, then CMMD as the default gate for generation launches.

Coordination with Tomas's team is the critical path; the math is done, the plumbing isn't.

Daniela — staffing + dependency plan please.

Lucia
